name: Fieldflow Calm component and overlay state contract

proofPolicy.rule: This manifest specifies required behavior and future evidence targets. A target path is not evidence. No component may advance beyond CONTRACTED until implementation paths, immutable artifacts with sha256 hashes, automated assertions and an independent review are recorded in acceptance.json.
forbiddenClaims: an expected screenshot path presented as an existing output
a source-level regex presented as runtime focus proof
a closed overlay presented as proof of its open, error or pending states
a default theme capture presented as proof of every tenant theme axis
a settled post-placement screenshot presented as proof of an active pointer drag, touch flow or keyboard positioning interaction

repositorySource.pathRule: sourcePath is a safe repository-relative path to an existing TypeScript or TSX source file; symbol is one exact named AST declaration in that file

prototypeArchivePath.pathRule: prototypeArchivePath is resolved only inside the immutable archive identified by archiveManifest and is never resolved as a repository sourcePath

captureFixtureContract.rule: Each fixture starts from a fresh authenticated tenant context with deterministic data, fixed Europe/Amsterdam time, reduced motion for visual capture and no prior overlay, toast, storage or focus state. Interaction traces additionally run with normal motion and keyboard or coarse pointer as declared.
requiredComputedMeasurements: active element before open, after open, after Escape and after close

caseExecutionMatrix.definitionCountRule: The manifest keeps exactly 60 base capture-case definitions: 29 paired desktop/mobile component cases plus two desktop-only active planboard interaction cases. The runner expands every definition over this matrix; expansion never creates or renames a capture case.

axisCoverage.rule: The 300 canonical viewport/zoom component runs are a required subset of this axis suite. Every critical execution unit is expanded over the full Cartesian product of its five applicable viewport/zoom profiles and every theme, density, motion, contrast and permission value. Every remaining component capture case uses the deterministic pair-closure algorithm, including one canonical-default seed for each applicable viewport/zoom profile. No axis value, pair or critical tuple may be sampled away.

remainingCasePairwise.axisPairIteration: axisOrder left-to-right; for every unordered axis pair enumerate left values then right values in declared order
remainingCasePairwise.otherAxisIndexFormula: (leftValueIndex*17 + rightValueIndex*31 + leftAxisIndex*7 + rightAxisIndex*11 + currentAxisIndex*13 + pairOrdinal) modulo currentAxisDomainLength
remainingCasePairwise.deduplicationKey: axis values joined in axisOrder with U+007C

focusContract.entry: Tapping Plan or Verplaats opens the full-screen wizard and focuses its title, then the first task field.
focusContract.error: One invalid field receives focus; more than one focuses FormErrorSummary; conflict review focuses its heading and safe action.
focusContract.success: Successful planning focuses the updated agenda item and announces exact employee, date and time.
focusContract.rollback: Failure restores the exact prior queue/agenda snapshot and focus to the initiating item or surviving action.
focusContract.cancel: Cancel or safe Escape returns to the exact Plan or Verplaats opener without mutation.
focusContract.undo: Undo restores the prior snapshot and returns focus to the restored item context.

focusContract.entry: Activating the explicit Timeline toggle opens the timeline, focuses its named keyboard instructions and then the selected queue item or current gridcell.

focusContract.success: Confirm focuses the moved block and announces employee, date and exact time.
focusContract.rollback: Mutation failure restores the prior block and active gridcell without moving focus to body.
focusContract.cancel: Escape exits movement mode before closing the timeline and restores the originating item.
focusContract.undo: Undo restores the prior position and focuses the restored block.

components.name: Accordion/Collapsible
stateRules: Every disclosure trigger exposes expanded state and controls exactly one named content region; heading level follows page hierarchy.
Accordion keyboard navigation is complete and disabled items are skipped; Collapsible remains an ordinary button plus controlled region.
Collapsed content is absent from tab and accessibility order, while reduced motion preserves immediate state and all nested controls.

focusContract.entry: Tab reaches the first enabled trigger; Accordion arrows/Home/End move among triggers and Collapsible uses normal tab order.
focusContract.escape: Closes an owned nested overlay first; disclosure itself changes only through its trigger unless the surrounding task explicitly contracts Escape.
focusContract.return: Expanding or collapsing keeps focus on the trigger; a nested control returns to its own opener inside expanded content.

responsiveContract.desktop: Trigger label, indicator and optional metadata keep hierarchy and 44px geometry; long content stays in document flow.
responsiveContract.mobile: Full-width triggers wrap without overlap; expanded long content and nested controls remain reachable without page-level horizontal overflow.

captureCases.interaction: Navigate all triggers, skip disabled, expand long content, enter/exit nested control, collapse and repeat with reduced motion while inspecting relationships.
Operate by touch and keyboard with long wrapped labels/content, verify 44px triggers, hidden collapsed content and no document overflow.

components.name: Planboard placement interaction

interactionModeParityContract.rule: Desktop active drag and keyboard frames remain their own evidence. Mobile functional parity is proved only by the referenced non-drag touch journey and the keyboard journey exposed through the explicit Timeline toggle; neither journey may be relabelled as pointer-drag evidence.

stateRules: Pointer evidence is captured while the pointer is still down and the drag is active: source, ghost, highlighted target, snapped time and evaluation state remain visible in one frame.
Valid, warning and blocked are three distinct semantic states. Warning and blocked expose a typed reason object and visible text/icon treatment; color alone and an untyped sentence are insufficient.

Dragging an existing block retains the exact grab offset through preview. The pointer probe grabs 45 minutes after block start and therefore previews 10:00 when the pointer is at 10:45 on a 15-minute raster.
Keyboard movement exposes a position preview before confirmation and an invalid-position state that retains the active gridcell and announces its typed reason.
No active-interaction claim may be satisfied by a settled post-placement or undo screenshot; no mutation occurs before pointer release or explicit keyboard confirmation.

focusContract.entry: Pointer starts on the full movable block hitarea; keyboard Enter or Space selects the focused queue item or movable block and names the positioning instructions.
focusContract.escape: Escape cancels active pointer or keyboard intent without mutation and restores the exact source block or queue item as the focus context.
focusContract.return: Valid confirmation focuses the placed block; warning first focuses explicit confirmation; blocked or invalid placement stays on the active target and announces the typed reason plus correction.

responsiveContract.desktop: At 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 px, active pointer drag and keyboard positioning keep ghost, target highlight, status label, typed reason and snapped times visible without page overflow.
responsiveContract.mobile: This component has no touch-drag capture case: 320, 390, 430 and 768 px render queue cards before the agenda and use the separately contracted full-screen non-drag wizard; the keyboard timeline appears only after the explicit Timeline toggle.

captureCases.interaction: Hold the existing FG-2048 block 45 minutes after its start, cross deterministic valid, warning and blocked targets without releasing, and capture every active frame before cancelling with Escape.

Select FG-2062 with Enter, move right by one 15-minute raster step and down by one employee to capture the valid preview, then move onto the deterministic overlap cell to capture invalid-position before Escape.
